tagline: Leading manufacturer of innovative water management solutions for stormwater and onsite septic wastewater industries
hero_kpi_rationale: Total revenue is the primary indicator of company size and growth in the water management solutions market, estimated at $15 billion.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Sales revenue generated from the sale of water management products and solutions.
kpis.description: Total revenue reflects the company's overall performance in its water management solutions markets.
kpis.signal: Stable growth in a market estimated at $15 billion.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, before other expenses.
kpis.description: Gross margin indicates production efficiency and product pricing effectiveness.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, adjusted, as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Measures operating profitability before certain non-cash and exceptional items.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in adjusted operating margin.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated by operations after deducting capital expenditures.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's ability to generate cash after necessary investments.
kpis.signal: Significant decline in free cash flow.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount spent to acquire or improve long-term physical assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures demonstrate the company's commitment to expansion and maintenance.

kpis.name: Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDA Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measures net debt relative to adjusted operating profitability.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's ability to repay debt with its operating earnings.

kpis.name: Working Capital
kpis.explanation: Current assets minus current liabilities, measure of short-term liquidity.
kpis.description: Working capital is essential for managing daily operations and short-term financing needs.
kpis.signal: Increase in working capital to support sales.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $2.904 billion in the most recent fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.18 in the most recent year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.05 billion in the most recent year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 reported fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 11.0% in the most recent year.

risks.title: Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company is sensitive to general economic conditions, including interest rates, unemployment rates and credit availability. Non-residential, residential, agricultural and infrastructure markets depend on key macroeconomic factors.

risks.title: Raw Material Prices
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in raw material prices, particularly resins, can impact the company's profitability. This is mentioned multiple times in the report.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, which can impact selling prices and market share. This is mentioned in the report.

risks.title: Supply Chain Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on suppliers for raw materials, which can create supply chain risks. This is mentioned in the report.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company operates internationally, which can create risks related to foreign exchange fluctuations. This is mentioned in the report.

risks.title: Seasonality
risks.score_rationale: The company is sensitive to seasonality, which can impact sales and production. This is mentioned in the report.

ai_positioning.summary: WMS does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
